data.name: Sahab
data.long_meaning: A man who is a close friend or companion, especially one who shares the same beliefs, or someone who fights alongside another in battle.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the bond and companionship between the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and his companions during their time in Mecca and Medina.
data.numerology_meaning: Creativity, self-expression, and communication are key aspects of your life path.

in_arabic.name: سحاب
in_arabic.meaning: سحاب هو الشخص الذي يملك صفات السماء و العلو
in_arabic.long_meaning: سحاب هو اسم مشتق من السحاب الذي يغطي السماء و يحمل المطر. في اللغة العربية، السحاب يرمز إلى الارتفاع و العلو. و في الثقافة الإسلامية، يعتبر السحاب رمزًا للرحمة و الغيث. كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفرقان الآية 2: 'وَهُوَ الَّذِيَ أَرْسَلَ السَّحَابَ ثُمَّ أَلْفَحَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَجَعَلَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ حَيٍّ'

in_urdu.name: سحاب
in_urdu.meaning: سحاب ایک ایسا شخص ہے جو بلند اور عالی شان ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: سحاب کا نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے بادلوں کا مجموعہ۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ بادلوں کو رحمت اور بارش کے دہنکے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے۔ قرآن مجید میں بھی سحاب کا ذکر مختلف آیات میں کیا گیا ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ فرقان میں

in_hindi.name: सحاب
in_hindi.meaning: सحاب एक ऐसा व्यक्ति है जो उच्च और महान गुणों वाला है
in_hindi.long_meaning: सحاب नाम की उत्पत्ति العربية भाषा से हुई है जिसका अर्थ है बादलों का समूह । यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में बहुत महत्व रखता है क्योंकि बादलों को रहमत और बारिश के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है । कुरआन में भी सحاب का उल्लेख विभिन्न आयतों में किया गया है, जैसे कि सूरा अल-फुरकान में ।

in_pashto.name: سحاب
in_pashto.meaning: سحاب داسی څوک چي لوړ او عالي شان وي
in_pashto.long_meaning: د سحاب نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی چي د بادلونو د مجموعې معنی لري. دا نوم د اسلامي کلتور کې ډیر اهمیت لري ځکه بادلونه د رحمت او باران د نښې په توګه لیدل کیږي. په قرآن کې د سحاب ذکر په مختلفو ایتونو کې شوی دی، لکه څنګه چې د سورة الفرقان په آیت 2 کې: 'وَهُوَ الَّذِيَ أَرْسَلَ السَّحَابَ ثُمَّ أَلْفَحَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَجَعَلَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ حَيٍّ'

in_english.name: Sahab
in_english.meaning: Sahab means a person with high and noble qualities
in_english.long_meaning: The name Sahab originates from Arabic, meaning 'clouds' or 'one who possesses high and noble qualities'. In Islamic culture, clouds symbolize mercy and rain. The term is mentioned in the Quran, such as in Surah Al-Furqan, Verse 2: 'And it is He who sends down the clouds, then brings them together, then makes them into droplets, and you see the rain coming forth from their midst.'

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic history, the Sahabah refer to the companions of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). They were the individuals who encountered the prophet directly, learned from him, and accepted his teachings. The Sahabah, who numbered around 10,000, played a crucial role in spreading Islam and building the early Islamic community. Their importance lies in their dedication to the cause of Islam and their role as witnesses to key events in Islamic history, including the Prophet's migration from Mecca to Medina, and his journeys and battles.
data.spiritual_significance: The term "Sahabah" holds significant spiritual meaning for Muslims. The Sahabah are regarded as role models and sources of inspiration for their faith, dedication, and sacrifice. Muslims strive to emulate their exemplary behavior and maintain their moral and spiritual standards. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) referred to the Sahabah as "the best generation" that Allah had created, and Muslims continue to honor and revere them as a testament to their unwavering commitment to Allah and to His Messenger (peace be upon him). Additionally, the Sahabah's closest companions and the companions of the Prophet's companions, collectively known as the Tabi'un, are also held in high esteem in Islamic tradition, demonstrating the importance of the relationships and connections that Muslims values. Overall, the Sahabah hold an important role in Islamic history as a source of spiritual inspiration and guidance for future generations.
